g.text: Choosing the node for a key, and failover (drawn from the 2.17.0 code)
[no current mapping for the cache (missing, or older than the last topology)]
(one thread at a time; others go without the map)
the call goes without the map
[connection error on the node channel (synchronous call)]
[until success, attempts used up, or the policy says no]
no channel open and failures = attempts
first try: a random open channel if partition awareness is on, more than
one channel is open and nothing has failed yet; otherwise the current default
holder, which moves on when it fails.
attempts = holders, or retryLimit if smaller and above 0;
one more with partition awareness and more than one open channel
